value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"The supplier said its customer, a rack integrator, rejected one lot of QD couplings for the first Rubin NVL144 pilot racks after leak testing at the integrator's facility.","tickers":["NVDA"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"QD coupling lot rejection for Rubin NVL144 pilot racks","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"The replacement lot is expected within roughly three weeks.","tickers":["NVDA"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"QD coupling replacement lot timing","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"The contact said that the destination for the pilot racks is a Microsoft AI campus.","tickers":["MSFT","NVDA"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"Rubin NVL144 pilot rack destination","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"If the pilot racks slip by around 3-4 weeks, the downstream effect might be a delay in Microsoft's first Rubin cluster qualification and a corresponding shift in Nvidia's rack shipment timing.","tickers":["MSFT","NVDA"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":"Rubin cluster qualification and rack shipment timing","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false},{"quote":"The impact on Nvidia's January-quarter numbers would be small unless the delays go beyond pilot-level volumes.","tickers":["NVDA"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":"impact on quarterly numbers","period":"January-quarter","value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
